title: 鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復
summary: 從焊接細節的應力範圍與 AASHTO 疲勞類別出發，區分載重誘發與變形誘發的疲勞裂縫，以斷裂韌性與 Paris 定律估算臨界尺寸與剩餘壽命，再處理止裂孔、錘擊、螺栓拼接、非破壞檢測、現場應變量測與斷裂關鍵構件的檢查交接，並以 Yellow Mill Pond、Lafayette Street、Hoan 與 I-40 Hernando de Soto 等橋為實例。
summaryEn: Starting from stress ranges at welded details and the AASHTO fatigue categories, distinguish load-induced from distortion-induced cracking, estimate critical size and remaining life with fracture toughness and the Paris law, then cover arrest holes, peening, bolted splices, nondestructive testing, field strain measurement and the inspection and handover of fracture-critical members, using the Yellow Mill Pond, Lafayette Street, Hoan and I-40 Hernando de Soto bridges as examples.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某 1970 年代鋼板梁橋受拉翼板的蓋板端部屬 AASHTO E′ 類（A = 3.9×10⁸ ksi³ ≈ 1.28×10¹¹ MPa³，常幅門檻約 18 MPa）。現場應變量測得有效應力範圍 S_re = 25 MPa、每天約 1,500 次循環（約 547,500 次/年）。(1) 疲勞壽命 N = 1.28×10¹¹/25³ ≈ 8.2×10⁶ 次，約 15 年，說明通車數十年的此類細節出現裂縫並不意外。(2) 檢查發現半長 a = 30 mm 的邊緣裂縫，取孔邊尖峰應力範圍限值 110 MPa、設計應力範圍 Δσ = 50 MPa：ρ ≥ 4×30×(50/110)² ≈ 24.8 mm，孔徑約 49.6 mm，邊緣裂縫加大 25% 約 62 mm，選用 64 mm（2.5 in）環形鑽，落在 FHWA 手冊 2 至 4 in 的經驗範圍。(3) 再以螺栓拼接板跨越蓋板端部，讓力量繞過受損斷面，並於一年內追蹤檢查孔緣。(4) 若改變一個輸入：S_re 改為 30 MPa，壽命變為 8.2×10⁶×(25/30)³ ≈ 4.7×10⁶ 次，約 8.6 年，應力範圍增加 20% 使壽命少了約 42%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a cover-plate end on the tension flange of a 1970s steel plate-girder bridge is AASHTO Category E′ (A = 3.9×10⁸ ksi³ ≈ 1.28×10¹¹ MPa³, constant-amplitude threshold about 18 MPa). Field strain measurement gives an effective stress range S_re = 25 MPa and about 1,500 cycles a day (about 547,500 a year). (1) Fatigue life N = 1.28×10¹¹/25³ ≈ 8.2×10⁶ cycles, about 15 years, so cracking at such a detail after decades of service is no surprise. (2) Inspection finds an edge crack of half-length a = 30 mm; with a peak hole-edge stress-range limit of 110 MPa and design stress range Δσ = 50 MPa, ρ ≥ 4×30×(50/110)² ≈ 24.8 mm, a diameter of about 49.6 mm, raised by 25% for an edge crack to about 62 mm, so a 64 mm (2.5 in) annular cutter is chosen, within the 2 to 4 in range supported in the FHWA manual. (3) Bolted splice plates then bridge the cover-plate end so force bypasses the damaged section, and the hole edges are re-inspected within a year. (4) Changing one input: with S_re = 30 MPa the life becomes 8.2×10⁶×(25/30)³ ≈ 4.7×10⁶ cycles, about 8.6 years, so a 20% higher stress range cuts life by about 42%. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「應力範圍與疲勞細節類別」與「變形誘發疲勞與腹板間隙」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stress range and fatigue detail categories" and "Distortion-induced fatigue in web gaps": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 應力範圍與疲勞細節類別：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stress range and fatigue detail categories: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「蓋板端部焊趾」如何影響鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cover-plate end weld toe” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼橋的疲勞裂縫幾乎都從焊接細節開始：焊趾的幾何不連續、殘餘拉應力與微小熔渣缺陷使局部應力集中，車輛每次通過造成的應力範圍（而不是最大應力）驅動裂縫逐步成長。AASHTO 把細節依疲勞強度分成 A 到 E′ 等類別，蓋板端部的橫向填角焊屬最差的 E 或 E′ 類，康乃狄克州 I-95 Yellow Mill Pond 橋的蓋板端部裂縫就是 FHWA 修復手冊中的典型照片。由於 S–N 曲線斜率為 3，應力範圍增加約 26% 壽命就減半，因此疲勞評估的核心是準確的應力範圍與循環次數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「蓋板端部焊趾」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fatigue cracks in steel bridges almost always start at welded details: the geometric discontinuity at the weld toe, tensile residual stress and tiny slag defects concentrate stress locally, and the stress range from each passing vehicle, not the peak stress, drives the crack forward. AASHTO groups details by fatigue strength into categories A to E′; transverse fillet welds at cover-plate ends are among the worst, Category E or E′, and the cracked cover-plate end on the I-95 Yellow Mill Pond Bridge in Connecticut is a classic illustration in the FHWA repair manual. Because the S–N curve has a slope of 3, a stress range about 26% higher halves the life, so fatigue assessment hinges on accurate stress ranges and cycle counts. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cover-plate end weld toe” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：N = A/(ΔF)³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: N = A/(ΔF)³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要最大應力低於降伏強度，鋼橋就不會發生疲勞裂縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as peak stress stays below yield, a steel bridge cannot develop fatigue cracks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「蓋板端部焊趾」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cover-plate end weld toe”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 應力範圍與疲勞細節類別
knowledge.titleEn: Stress range and fatigue detail categories

knowledge.textEn: Fatigue cracks in steel bridges almost always start at welded details: the geometric discontinuity at the weld toe, tensile residual stress and tiny slag defects concentrate stress locally, and the stress range from each passing vehicle, not the peak stress, drives the crack forward. AASHTO groups details by fatigue strength into categories A to E′; transverse fillet welds at cover-plate ends are among the worst, Category E or E′, and the cracked cover-plate end on the I-95 Yellow Mill Pond Bridge in Connecticut is a classic illustration in the FHWA repair manual.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要最大應力低於降伏強度，鋼橋就不會發生疲勞裂縫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as peak stress stays below yield, a steel bridge cannot develop fatigue cracks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「應力範圍與疲勞細節類別」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stress range and fatigue detail categories" is correct?
options: 只要最大應力低於降伏強度，鋼橋就不會發生疲勞裂縫。
鋼橋的疲勞裂縫幾乎都從焊接細節開始：焊趾的幾何不連續、殘餘拉應力與微小熔渣缺陷使局部應力集中，車輛每次通過造成的應力範圍（而不是最大應力）驅動裂縫逐步成長。
腹板間隙的變形只有百分之幾毫米，不可能造成裂縫。
optionsEn: As long as peak stress stays below yield, a steel bridge cannot develop fatigue cracks.

Fatigue cracks in steel bridges almost always start at welded details: the geometric discontinuity at the weld toe, tensile residual stress and tiny slag defects concentrate stress locally, and the stress range from each passing vehicle, not the peak stress, drives the crack forward.
Web-gap distortions are only hundredths of a millimetre, so they cannot cause cracks.
quiz.explanation: 鋼橋的疲勞裂縫幾乎都從焊接細節開始：焊趾的幾何不連續、殘餘拉應力與微小熔渣缺陷使局部應力集中，車輛每次通過造成的應力範圍（而不是最大應力）驅動裂縫逐步成長。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fatigue cracks in steel bridges almost always start at welded details: the geometric discontinuity at the weld toe, tensile residual stress and tiny slag defects concentrate stress locally, and the stress range from each passing vehicle, not the peak stress, drives the crack forward. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 應力範圍與疲勞細節類別：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stress range and fatigue detail categories: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「蓋板端部焊趾」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cover-plate end weld toe” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：N = A/(ΔF)³。E 類 A = 11.0×10⁸ ksi³ ≈ 3.61×10¹¹ MPa³；有效應力範圍 ΔF = 40 MPa 時 N = 3.61×10¹¹/40³ ≈ 5.6×10⁶ 次，若每天 2,000 輛卡車各造成一次循環，約 7.7 年；同樣應力下 C 類（A ≈ 1.44×10¹² MPa³）約 2.25×10⁷ 次、約 31 年。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: N = A/(ΔF)³. For Category E, A = 11.0×10⁸ ksi³ ≈ 3.61×10¹¹ MPa³; at an effective stress range ΔF = 40 MPa, N = 3.61×10¹¹/40³ ≈ 5.6×10⁶ cycles, or about 7.7 years if 2,000 trucks a day each cause one cycle. At the same stress a Category C detail (A ≈ 1.44×10¹² MPa³) lasts about 2.25×10⁷ cycles, about 31 years. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以竣工圖與現場檢查列出每一個疲勞敏感細節並標註 AASHTO 類別，用影響線與實測交通量計算有效應力範圍與累積循環次數；再與細節的常幅疲勞門檻（例如 E 類 4.5 ksi，約 31 MPa）比較，判斷屬有限壽命或無限壽命區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List every fatigue-sensitive detail from as-built drawings and field inspection and tag its AASHTO category, compute effective stress range and accumulated cycles from influence lines and measured traffic, then compare with the detail's constant-amplitude threshold (for example 4.5 ksi, about 31 MPa, for Category E) to decide whether it lies in the finite-life or infinite-life region.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: N = A/(ΔF)³。E 類 A = 11.0×10⁸ ksi³ ≈ 3.61×10¹¹ MPa³；有效應力範圍 ΔF = 40 MPa 時 N = 3.61×10¹¹/40³ ≈ 5.6×10⁶ 次，若每天 2,000 輛卡車各造成一次循環，約 7.7 年；同樣應力下 C 類（A ≈ 1.44×10¹² MPa³）約 2.25×10⁷ 次、約 31 年。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: N = A/(ΔF)³. For Category E, A = 11.0×10⁸ ksi³ ≈ 3.61×10¹¹ MPa³; at an effective stress range ΔF = 40 MPa, N = 3.61×10¹¹/40³ ≈ 5.6×10⁶ cycles, or about 7.7 years if 2,000 trucks a day each cause one cycle. At the same stress a Category C detail (A ≈ 1.44×10¹² MPa³) lasts about 2.25×10⁷ cycles, about 31 years. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「應力範圍與疲勞細節類別」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stress range and fatigue detail categories", which statement holds?
options: 裂縫每年增加的長度是固定的，可以直接線性外推。
只要把裂縫焊補起來，構件就恢復原來的疲勞強度。
N = A/(ΔF)³。
optionsEn: A crack grows by the same length every year, so it can be extrapolated linearly.
Simply weld-repairing a crack restores the member's original fatigue strength.
N = A/(ΔF)³.
quiz.explanation: N = A/(ΔF)³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: N = A/(ΔF)³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 應力範圍與疲勞細節類別：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stress range and fatigue detail categories: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「蓋板端部焊趾」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cover-plate end weld toe” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以竣工圖與現場檢查列出每一個疲勞敏感細節並標註 AASHTO 類別，用影響線與實測交通量計算有效應力範圍與累積循環次數；再與細節的常幅疲勞門檻（例如 E 類 4.5 ksi，約 31 MPa）比較，判斷屬有限壽命或無限壽命區。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List every fatigue-sensitive detail from as-built drawings and field inspection and tag its AASHTO category, compute effective stress range and accumulated cycles from influence lines and measured traffic, then compare with the detail's constant-amplitude threshold (for example 4.5 ksi, about 31 MPa, for Category E) to decide whether it lies in the finite-life or infinite-life region. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：新建設計避免使用 E 與 E′ 類細節；既有橋的疲勞清冊要依細節類別與應力範圍排序檢查優先順序，並把每一個 E′ 類細節的位置標在檢查圖上，作為每次例行檢查必看的點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Avoid Category E and E′ details in new design; for existing bridges, rank the fatigue inventory by detail category and stress range to set inspection priority, and mark every Category E′ detail on the inspection drawings as a must-see point at each routine inspection.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：蓋板端部的焊趾裂縫先在翼板內穿透厚度，再沿翼板寬度擴展；若未及時發現，裂縫可貫穿整個受拉翼板並進入腹板，FHWA 手冊收錄的明尼蘇達州聖保羅 Lafayette Street 橋就出現貫穿整個梁深的疲勞裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A weld-toe crack at a cover-plate end first grows through the flange thickness and then across its width; if missed, it can sever the whole tension flange and run into the web, as in the full-girder-depth fatigue crack of the Lafayette Street Bridge in St. Paul, Minnesota, shown in the FHWA manual. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以竣工圖與現場檢查列出每一個疲勞敏感細節並標註 AASHTO 類別，用影響線與實測交通量計算有效應力範圍與累積循環次數；再與細節的常幅疲勞門檻（例如 E 類 4.5 ksi，約 31 MPa）比較，判斷屬有限壽命或無限壽命區。
knowledge.textEn: List every fatigue-sensitive detail from as-built drawings and field inspection and tag its AASHTO category, compute effective stress range and accumulated cycles from influence lines and measured traffic, then compare with the detail's constant-amplitude threshold (for example 4.5 ksi, about 31 MPa, for Category E) to decide whether it lies in the finite-life or infinite-life region.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 新建設計避免使用 E 與 E′ 類細節；既有橋的疲勞清冊要依細節類別與應力範圍排序檢查優先順序，並把每一個 E′ 類細節的位置標在檢查圖上，作為每次例行檢查必看的點。
knowledge.textEn: Avoid Category E and E′ details in new design; for existing bridges, rank the fatigue inventory by detail category and stress range to set inspection priority, and mark every Category E′ detail on the inspection drawings as a must-see point at each routine inspection.

quiz.question: 要驗證「應力範圍與疲勞細節類別」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stress range and fatigue detail categories"?
options: 以竣工圖與現場檢查列出每一個疲勞敏感細節並標註 AASHTO 類別，用影響線與實測交通量計算有效應力範圍與累積循環次數。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
疲勞評估只要用規範的疲勞卡車計算，不需要現場量測。
optionsEn: List every fatigue-sensitive detail from as-built drawings and field inspection and tag its AASHTO category, compute effective stress range and accumulated cycles from influence lines and measured traffic, then compare with the detail's constant-amplitude threshold (for example 4.5 ksi, about 31 MPa, for Category E) to decide whether it lies in the finite-life or infinite-life region.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Fatigue assessment needs only the code fatigue truck, never field measurement.
quiz.explanation: 以竣工圖與現場檢查列出每一個疲勞敏感細節並標註 AASHTO 類別，用影響線與實測交通量計算有效應力範圍與累積循環次數；再與細節的常幅疲勞門檻（例如 E 類 4.5 ksi，約 31 MPa）比較，判斷屬有限壽命或無限壽命區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: List every fatigue-sensitive detail from as-built drawings and field inspection and tag its AASHTO category, compute effective stress range and accumulated cycles from influence lines and measured traffic, then compare with the detail's constant-amplitude threshold (for example 4.5 ksi, about 31 MPa, for Category E) to decide whether it lies in the finite-life or infinite-life region. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 應力範圍與疲勞細節類別：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stress range and fatigue detail categories: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「蓋板端部焊趾」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cover-plate end weld toe” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 蓋板端部的焊趾裂縫先在翼板內穿透厚度，再沿翼板寬度擴展；若未及時發現，裂縫可貫穿整個受拉翼板並進入腹板，FHWA 手冊收錄的明尼蘇達州聖保羅 Lafayette Street 橋就出現貫穿整個梁深的疲勞裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A weld-toe crack at a cover-plate end first grows through the flange thickness and then across its width; if missed, it can sever the whole tension flange and run into the web, as in the full-girder-depth fatigue crack of the Lafayette Street Bridge in St. Paul, Minnesota, shown in the FHWA manual. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：由於 S–N 曲線斜率為 3，應力範圍增加約 26% 壽命就減半，因此疲勞評估的核心是準確的應力範圍與循環次數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because the S–N curve has a slope of 3, a stress range about 26% higher halves the life, so fatigue assessment hinges on accurate stress ranges and cycle counts.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要最大應力低於降伏強度，鋼橋就不會發生疲勞裂縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as peak stress stays below yield, a steel bridge cannot develop fatigue cracks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「應力範圍與疲勞細節類別」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stress range and fatigue detail categories" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
蓋板端部的焊趾裂縫先在翼板內穿透厚度，再沿翼板寬度擴展。
腹板間隙的變形只有百分之幾毫米，不可能造成裂縫。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A weld-toe crack at a cover-plate end first grows through the flange thickness and then across its width.
Web-gap distortions are only hundredths of a millimetre, so they cannot cause cracks.
quiz.explanation: 蓋板端部的焊趾裂縫先在翼板內穿透厚度，再沿翼板寬度擴展；若未及時發現，裂縫可貫穿整個受拉翼板並進入腹板，FHWA 手冊收錄的明尼蘇達州聖保羅 Lafayette Street 橋就出現貫穿整個梁深的疲勞裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A weld-toe crack at a cover-plate end first grows through the flange thickness and then across its width; if missed, it can sever the whole tension flange and run into the web, as in the full-girder-depth fatigue crack of the Lafayette Street Bridge in St. Paul, Minnesota, shown in the FHWA manual. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 變形誘發疲勞與腹板間隙：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Distortion-induced fatigue in web gaps: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「連接板腹板間隙」如何影響鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Connection-plate web gap” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主梁間的橫隔或橫構架在活載下使相鄰主梁產生不同撓度，若橫構架連接板沒有與受拉翼板相連，連接板端部與翼板之間的一小段腹板（腹板間隙）就被迫承受面外變形。這段腹板很短，極小的相對位移就產生很大的二次彎曲應力，形成平行於焊道的裂縫。FHWA 手冊估計變形誘發的開裂佔全部疲勞裂縫的 90% 以上，1985 年以前的設計普遍有此細節，例如明尼蘇達州約 85% 的鋼橋建於 1986 年以前。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「連接板腹板間隙」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Under live load, diaphragms or cross-frames between girders force adjacent girders to deflect differently; if the cross-frame connection plate is not attached to the tension flange, the short strip of web between the plate end and the flange, the web gap, must absorb out-of-plane distortion. Because the strip is so short, a tiny relative displacement produces large secondary bending stress and cracks parallel to the weld. The FHWA manual estimates that distortion-induced cracking causes over 90% of all fatigue cracking, and the detail was common in designs before 1985; in Minnesota, for example, about 85% of steel bridges were built before 1986. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Connection-plate web gap” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩端固定的腹板間隙在面外相對位移 Δ 下，彎曲應力 σ = 3E·t·Δ/g²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a web gap fixed at both ends under relative out-of-plane displacement Δ, the bending stress is σ = 3E·t·Δ/g².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「腹板間隙的變形只有百分之幾毫米，不可能造成裂縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Web-gap distortions are only hundredths of a millimetre, so they cannot cause cracks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「連接板腹板間隙」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Connection-plate web gap”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 主梁間的橫隔或橫構架在活載下使相鄰主梁產生不同撓度，若橫構架連接板沒有與受拉翼板相連，連接板端部與翼板之間的一小段腹板（腹板間隙）就被迫承受面外變形。這段腹板很短，極小的相對位移就產生很大的二次彎曲應力，形成平行於焊道的裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: Under live load, diaphragms or cross-frames between girders force adjacent girders to deflect differently; if the cross-frame connection plate is not attached to the tension flange, the short strip of web between the plate end and the flange, the web gap, must absorb out-of-plane distortion. Because the strip is so short, a tiny relative displacement produces large secondary bending stress and cracks parallel to the weld.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：腹板間隙的變形只有百分之幾毫米，不可能造成裂縫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Web-gap distortions are only hundredths of a millimetre, so they cannot cause cracks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「變形誘發疲勞與腹板間隙」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Distortion-induced fatigue in web gaps" is correct?
options: 腹板間隙的變形只有百分之幾毫米，不可能造成裂縫。
鋼材是延性材料，所以鋼橋只會先變形再破壞，不會突然斷裂。
主梁間的橫隔或橫構架在活載下使相鄰主梁產生不同撓度，若橫構架連接板沒有與受拉翼板相連，連接板端部與翼板之間的一小段腹板（腹板間隙）就被迫承受面外變形。
optionsEn: Web-gap distortions are only hundredths of a millimetre, so they cannot cause cracks.
Steel is ductile, so a steel bridge always deforms visibly before it fails and never fractures suddenly.
Under live load, diaphragms or cross-frames between girders force adjacent girders to deflect differently.
quiz.explanation: 主梁間的橫隔或橫構架在活載下使相鄰主梁產生不同撓度，若橫構架連接板沒有與受拉翼板相連，連接板端部與翼板之間的一小段腹板（腹板間隙）就被迫承受面外變形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Under live load, diaphragms or cross-frames between girders force adjacent girders to deflect differently; if the cross-frame connection plate is not attached to the tension flange, the short strip of web between the plate end and the flange, the web gap, must absorb out-of-plane distortion. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 變形誘發疲勞與腹板間隙：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Distortion-induced fatigue in web gaps: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「連接板腹板間隙」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Connection-plate web gap” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩端固定的腹板間隙在面外相對位移 Δ 下，彎曲應力 σ = 3E·t·Δ/g²。取 E = 200 GPa、腹板厚 t = 12 mm、Δ = 0.05 mm、間隙 g = 50 mm：σ = 3×200,000×12×0.05/50² = 144 MPa；若切除材料把間隙放大到 100 mm，σ 降為 36 MPa，只剩四分之一。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a web gap fixed at both ends under relative out-of-plane displacement Δ, the bending stress is σ = 3E·t·Δ/g². With E = 200 GPa, web thickness t = 12 mm, Δ = 0.05 mm and gap g = 50 mm, σ = 3×200,000×12×0.05/50² = 144 MPa; enlarging the gap to 100 mm by removing material drops σ to 36 MPa, one quarter. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在連接板端部上下方的腹板兩面貼應變計，量測卡車通過時的面外彎曲應變，與有限元素模型的熱點應力比較；FHWA 手冊以距焊趾約 1/4 in（6 mm）處的熱點應力對照 C 類曲線評估腹板間隙。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit strain gauges on both faces of the web above and below the connection-plate end, measure out-of-plane bending strain as trucks pass and compare with hot-spot stresses from a finite-element model; the FHWA manual assesses web gaps using the hot-spot stress about 1/4 in (6 mm) from the weld toe against the Category C curve.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 兩端固定的腹板間隙在面外相對位移 Δ 下，彎曲應力 σ = 3E·t·Δ/g²。取 E = 200 GPa、腹板厚 t = 12 mm、Δ = 0.05 mm、間隙 g = 50 mm：σ = 3×200,000×12×0.05/50² = 144 MPa；若切除材料把間隙放大到 100 mm，σ 降為 36 MPa，只剩四分之一。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a web gap fixed at both ends under relative out-of-plane displacement Δ, the bending stress is σ = 3E·t·Δ/g². With E = 200 GPa, web thickness t = 12 mm, Δ = 0.05 mm and gap g = 50 mm, σ = 3×200,000×12×0.05/50² = 144 MPa; enlarging the gap to 100 mm by removing material drops σ to 36 MPa, one quarter. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「變形誘發疲勞與腹板間隙」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Distortion-induced fatigue in web gaps", which statement holds?
options: 兩端固定的腹板間隙在面外相對位移 Δ 下，彎曲應力 σ = 3E·t·Δ/g²。
止裂孔越小越好，因為開孔會削弱斷面。
目視檢查沒有看到裂縫，就表示焊接細節沒有裂縫。
optionsEn: For a web gap fixed at both ends under relative out-of-plane displacement Δ, the bending stress is σ = 3E·t·Δ/g².
Arrest holes should be as small as possible because holes weaken the section.
If visual inspection shows no crack, the welded detail has no crack.
quiz.explanation: 兩端固定的腹板間隙在面外相對位移 Δ 下，彎曲應力 σ = 3E·t·Δ/g²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a web gap fixed at both ends under relative out-of-plane displacement Δ, the bending stress is σ = 3E·t·Δ/g². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 變形誘發疲勞與腹板間隙：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Distortion-induced fatigue in web gaps: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「連接板腹板間隙」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Connection-plate web gap” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在連接板端部上下方的腹板兩面貼應變計，量測卡車通過時的面外彎曲應變，與有限元素模型的熱點應力比較；FHWA 手冊以距焊趾約 1/4 in（6 mm）處的熱點應力對照 C 類曲線評估腹板間隙。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit strain gauges on both faces of the web above and below the connection-plate end, measure out-of-plane bending strain as trucks pass and compare with hot-spot stresses from a finite-element model; the FHWA manual assesses web gaps using the hot-spot stress about 1/4 in (6 mm) from the weld toe against the Category C curve. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：修復腹板間隙要先決定策略：加勁（以螺栓角鋼或 T 型鋼把連接板接到翼板）或軟化（放大間隙、移除或移位橫構架），不可兩者混用；任何修復都要先量測再設計，修復後再量一次確認應力確實下降。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Choose the web-gap strategy first: stiffening (bolting the connection plate to the flange with angles or a tee) or softening (enlarging the gap, removing or repositioning the cross-frame), never a mix; measure before designing any repair and measure again afterwards to confirm the stress has actually dropped.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「斷裂韌性與脆性斷裂」與「裂縫成長速率與剩餘壽命」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 斷裂韌性與脆性斷裂：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fracture toughness and brittle fracture: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「臨界裂縫與 Charpy 韌性」如何影響鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Critical crack and Charpy toughness” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 疲勞裂縫本身不會讓橋倒塌，真正的危險是裂縫長到臨界尺寸後在低溫下脆性斷裂。臨界尺寸由材料韌性、應力大小與幾何拘束決定；1967 年 Silver Bridge 因無冗餘眼桿脆斷而倒塌，促成 1970 年代的斷裂控制計畫與 Charpy V 型缺口韌性要求。2000 年 12 月密爾瓦基 Hoan 橋三根主梁中有兩根斷裂，FHWA 手冊指出這是在沒有先前疲勞裂縫下發生的脆性斷裂；焊接板件交會形成的高拘束使鋼材無法藉降伏釋放應力，冬季低溫又降低了韌性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「臨界裂縫與 Charpy 韌性」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A fatigue crack alone does not drop a bridge; the real danger is that once it reaches critical size it can fracture in a brittle way at low temperature. Critical size depends on toughness, stress level and geometric constraint. The 1967 collapse of the Silver Bridge through brittle fracture of a non-redundant eyebar led to the fracture control plan and Charpy V-notch toughness requirements of the 1970s. In December 2000 two of the three girders of Milwaukee's Hoan Bridge fractured; the FHWA manual describes it as brittle fracture without prior fatigue cracking, where highly constrained intersecting welded plates prevented the steel from relieving stress by yielding and winter cold reduced its toughness. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Critical crack and Charpy toughness” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：臨界裂縫 a_c = (1/π)·[K_Ic/(Y·σ_max)]²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Critical crack size a_c = (1/π)·[K_Ic/(Y·σ_max)]².

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Steel is ductile, so a steel bridge always deforms visibly before it fails and never fractures suddenly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「斷裂韌性與脆性斷裂」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fracture toughness and brittle fracture" is correct?

steps.title: 斷裂韌性與脆性斷裂：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fracture toughness and brittle fracture: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「臨界裂縫與 Charpy 韌性」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Critical crack and Charpy toughness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：臨界裂縫 a_c = (1/π)·[K_Ic/(Y·σ_max)]²。取 K_Ic = 100 MPa√m、邊緣裂縫 Y = 1.12、σ_max = 150 MPa：a_c = (1/π)×(100/168)² ≈ 0.113 m = 113 mm；低溫使 K_Ic 降為 50 MPa√m 時 a_c 只剩約 28 mm，為原來的四分之一。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Critical crack size a_c = (1/π)·[K_Ic/(Y·σ_max)]². Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從構件取樣或查閱鋼材證明書，在對應設計最低溫度的試驗溫度做 Charpy V 型缺口衝擊試驗，與 AASHTO 依溫度區及斷裂關鍵構件分級的要求比較；同時檢查焊接板件交會、零間隙相交等高拘束細節。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Take samples from the member or review the mill certificates, run Charpy V-notch impact tests at the test temperature corresponding to the lowest design temperature and compare with AASHTO requirements by temperature zone and fracture-critical classification; also check for highly constrained details such as intersecting welded plates with zero gap.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

optionsEn: If visual inspection shows no crack, the welded detail has no crack.
Once a crack is repaired, the normal two-year cycle can resume without follow-up.

steps.title: 裂縫成長速率與剩餘壽命：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Crack-growth rate and remaining life: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「裂縫成長曲線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crack-growth curve” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以兩次以上檢查量到的裂縫長度與時間間隔，比較實際成長率與模型預測；若實測成長較快，代表應力範圍或循環次數被低估，必須補量應變並縮短檢查間隔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use crack lengths measured at two or more inspections and the time between them to compare the actual growth rate with the model; faster measured growth means the stress range or cycle count was underestimated, so strains must be measured and the inspection interval shortened. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每一條已知裂縫都要有編號、量測方法、量測日期與照片，報告中附上依斷裂力學估算的剩餘壽命與下次檢查日期；初始尺寸、應力範圍與韌性等假設必須寫明，讓下一位工程師可以更新計算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Give every known crack a number, measurement method, date and photograph, and attach to the report a fracture-mechanics estimate of remaining life and the next inspection date; state the assumptions on initial size, stress range and toughness so the next engineer can update the calculation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若認為裂縫只有幾公釐、可以等下次定期檢查再處理，卻忽略交通量增加已使應力範圍上升，裂縫可能在兩次檢查之間由穩定成長轉為快速成長，等到發現時已接近臨界尺寸。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Deciding that a crack of a few millimetres can wait for the next routine inspection, while ignoring that heavier traffic has raised the stress range, lets the crack accelerate between inspections and approach critical size by the time it is found again. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 裂縫成長速率與剩餘壽命：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Crack-growth rate and remaining life: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裂縫成長曲線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Crack-growth curve” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若認為裂縫只有幾公釐、可以等下次定期檢查再處理，卻忽略交通量增加已使應力範圍上升，裂縫可能在兩次檢查之間由穩定成長轉為快速成長，等到發現時已接近臨界尺寸。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Deciding that a crack of a few millimetres can wait for the next routine inspection, while ignoring that heavier traffic has raised the stress range, lets the crack accelerate between inspections and approach critical size by the time it is found again. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：剩餘壽命取決於目前尺寸、臨界尺寸與應力範圍，這也說明及早找到短裂縫的價值遠大於事後補強。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Remaining life depends on current size, critical size and stress range, which is why finding short cracks early is worth far more than strengthening afterwards.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「裂縫每年增加的長度是固定的，可以直接線性外推。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A crack grows by the same length every year, so it can be extrapolated linearly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 若認為裂縫只有幾公釐、可以等下次定期檢查再處理，卻忽略交通量增加已使應力範圍上升，裂縫可能在兩次檢查之間由穩定成長轉為快速成長，等到發現時已接近臨界尺寸。
knowledge.textEn: Deciding that a crack of a few millimetres can wait for the next routine inspection, while ignoring that heavier traffic has raised the stress range, lets the crack accelerate between inspections and approach critical size by the time it is found again.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「裂縫成長速率與剩餘壽命」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Crack-growth rate and remaining life" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若認為裂縫只有幾公釐、可以等下次定期檢查再處理，卻忽略交通量增加已使應力範圍上升，裂縫可能在兩次檢查之間由穩定成長轉為快速成長，等到發現時已接近臨界尺寸。
止裂孔越小越好，因為開孔會削弱斷面。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

Deciding that a crack of a few millimetres can wait for the next routine inspection, while ignoring that heavier traffic has raised the stress range, lets the crack accelerate between inspections and approach critical size by the time it is found again.
Arrest holes should be as small as possible because holes weaken the section.
quiz.explanation: 若認為裂縫只有幾公釐、可以等下次定期檢查再處理，卻忽略交通量增加已使應力範圍上升，裂縫可能在兩次檢查之間由穩定成長轉為快速成長，等到發現時已接近臨界尺寸。 需以量測區分可能原因。

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「止裂孔的尺寸與施作」與「錘擊處理與螺栓拼接補強」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sizing and drilling crack-arrest holes" and "Peening and bolted splice repairs": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 止裂孔的尺寸與施作：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Sizing and drilling crack-arrest holes: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「裂尖止裂孔」如何影響鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crack-tip arrest hole” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 止裂孔是在裂尖鑽一個圓孔，把尖銳裂尖換成有限半徑的缺口，使局部應力集中降到不足以重新起裂。FHWA 手冊稱鑽孔可能是最常用的疲勞裂縫修復法，要求最小孔徑 1.0 in（25.4 mm），邊緣裂縫的計算孔徑要加大 25%，現場經驗支持 2 至 4 in 的孔徑；孔要以環形鑽施作，嚴禁火焰切割，孔緣須磨平去毛邊。孔必須真正包含裂尖，否則裂縫會從孔外繼續成長。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「裂尖止裂孔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An arrest hole drilled at the crack tip replaces the sharp tip with a notch of finite radius, lowering the local stress concentration below what is needed to re-initiate cracking. The FHWA manual calls hole drilling perhaps the most widely used fatigue-crack repair, requires a minimum diameter of 1.0 in (25.4 mm), increases the calculated diameter by 25% for edge cracks, and notes that field experience supports holes of 2 to 4 in; holes are cut with annular cutters, never flame-cut, and their edges ground smooth. The hole must truly contain the crack tip, or the crack simply continues outside it. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Crack-tip arrest hole” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 Creager–Paris 鈍化缺口關係，孔邊尖峰應力範圍 Δσ_max ≈ 2ΔK/√(πρ) = 2Δσ√(a/ρ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: By the Creager–Paris blunt-notch relation, the peak stress range at the hole edge is Δσ_max ≈ 2ΔK/√(πρ) = 2Δσ√(a/ρ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「止裂孔越小越好，因為開孔會削弱斷面。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Arrest holes should be as small as possible because holes weaken the section." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「裂尖止裂孔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Crack-tip arrest hole”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 止裂孔的尺寸與施作
knowledge.text: 止裂孔是在裂尖鑽一個圓孔，把尖銳裂尖換成有限半徑的缺口，使局部應力集中降到不足以重新起裂。FHWA 手冊稱鑽孔可能是最常用的疲勞裂縫修復法，要求最小孔徑 1.0 in（25.4 mm），邊緣裂縫的計算孔徑要加大 25%，現場經驗支持 2 至 4 in 的孔徑；孔要以環形鑽施作，嚴禁火焰切割，孔緣須磨平去毛邊。
knowledge.textEn: An arrest hole drilled at the crack tip replaces the sharp tip with a notch of finite radius, lowering the local stress concentration below what is needed to re-initiate cracking. The FHWA manual calls hole drilling perhaps the most widely used fatigue-crack repair, requires a minimum diameter of 1.0 in (25.4 mm), increases the calculated diameter by 25% for edge cracks, and notes that field experience supports holes of 2 to 4 in; holes are cut with annular cutters, never flame-cut, and their edges ground smooth.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：止裂孔越小越好，因為開孔會削弱斷面。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Arrest holes should be as small as possible because holes weaken the section. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「止裂孔的尺寸與施作」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sizing and drilling crack-arrest holes" is correct?
options: 止裂孔越小越好，因為開孔會削弱斷面。
只要把裂縫焊補起來，構件就恢復原來的疲勞強度。
止裂孔是在裂尖鑽一個圓孔，把尖銳裂尖換成有限半徑的缺口，使局部應力集中降到不足以重新起裂。
optionsEn: Arrest holes should be as small as possible because holes weaken the section.
Simply weld-repairing a crack restores the member's original fatigue strength.
An arrest hole drilled at the crack tip replaces the sharp tip with a notch of finite radius, lowering the local stress concentration below what is needed to re-initiate cracking.
quiz.explanation: 止裂孔是在裂尖鑽一個圓孔，把尖銳裂尖換成有限半徑的缺口，使局部應力集中降到不足以重新起裂。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An arrest hole drilled at the crack tip replaces the sharp tip with a notch of finite radius, lowering the local stress concentration below what is needed to re-initiate cracking. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 止裂孔的尺寸與施作：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sizing and drilling crack-arrest holes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裂尖止裂孔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crack-tip arrest hole” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 Creager–Paris 鈍化缺口關係，孔邊尖峰應力範圍 Δσ_max ≈ 2ΔK/√(πρ) = 2Δσ√(a/ρ)。要求 Δσ_max ≤ 110 MPa（教學門檻），裂縫半長 a = 40 mm、Δσ = 30 MPa：ρ ≥ 4a(Δσ/110)² = 4×40×(30/110)² ≈ 11.9 mm，孔徑約 24 mm，依最小值取 25.4 mm；若為邊緣裂縫加大 25% 約 30 mm，取 32 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: By the Creager–Paris blunt-notch relation, the peak stress range at the hole edge is Δσ_max ≈ 2ΔK/√(πρ) = 2Δσ√(a/ρ). Requiring Δσ_max ≤ 110 MPa (a teaching limit) for a crack half-length a = 40 mm and Δσ = 30 MPa gives ρ ≥ 4a(Δσ/110)² = 4×40×(30/110)² ≈ 11.9 mm, a diameter of about 24 mm, raised to the 25.4 mm minimum; for an edge crack, adding 25% gives about 30 mm, so use 32 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鑽孔前以磁粉或染色滲透確認裂尖位置，FHWA 手冊建議先鑽約 1/8 in 的參考小孔檢查背面裂尖；鑽孔後再以染色滲透檢查孔壁與孔緣，確認沒有殘留裂尖，並記錄孔位座標與孔徑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before drilling, locate the crack tip with magnetic particle or dye penetrant; the FHWA manual suggests a reference hole of about 1/8 in to check the tip on the far side.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

After the 2021 tie-girder fracture on the I-40 Hernando de Soto Bridge, plates were first added on both sides to stabilise the member, then more plating bypassed the fracture and a smaller damaged piece was removed. steps.title: 錘擊處理與螺栓拼接補強：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「螺栓拼接板與錘擊焊趾」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bolted splices and peened toes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：受拉翼板 400×25 mm 裂斷，需傳遞力 F = 120 MPa×10,000 mm² = 1,200 kN。以兩片拼接板夾住翼板形成雙摩擦面，每支 7/8 in（M22 級）高強度螺栓預拉 173 kN、滑動係數 0.50：每支抗滑 0.50×173×2 = 173 kN，裂縫每側需 1,200/173 ≈ 6.9 支，取 8 支。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A cracked 400×25 mm tension flange must transfer F = 120 MPa×10,000 mm² = 1,200 kN. Two splice plates sandwiching the flange give two slip planes; with 7/8 in (M22-class) high-strength bolts pretensioned to 173 kN and a slip coefficient of 0.50, each bolt resists 0.50×173×2 = 173 kN, so each side of the crack needs 1,200/173 ≈ 6.9 bolts, rounded to 8. Values are teaching assumptions. steps.instruction: 目視只能找到已經使油漆開裂的裂縫，確認長度與裂尖位置要靠非破壞檢測。FHWA 手冊說明染色滲透與磁粉是最簡便常用的方法：染色滲透以三種藥劑讓顯像劑把滲入裂縫的染料吸出；磁粉可找到表面及部分近表面裂縫，但隔著油漆並不可靠。量測裂縫深度需要超音波或繞射時差法（TOFD），設備與人員資格要求都較高。檢測前必須去除油漆與鏽皮，檢測後再補塗防蝕。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「染色滲透、磁粉與超音波」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Visual inspection finds only cracks that have already split the paint; confirming length and tip location needs nondestructive testing. Paint and mill scale must be removed before testing and the coating restored afterwards. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Dye penetrant, MT and ultrasonics” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dye penetrant, MT and ultrasonics” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：TOFD 以兩探頭間距 2S 量測裂尖繞射波到達時間 t，深度 d = √[(c·t/2)² − S²]。縱波速 c = 5.92 mm/μs、S = 30 mm、t = 12.0 μs：c·t/2 = 35.52 mm，d = √(35.52² − 30²) ≈ 19.0 mm；t 增為 12.5 μs 時 d ≈ 21.7 mm，0.5 μs 的時間差約代表 2.7 mm 深度。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: TOFD measures the arrival time t of the wave diffracted from the crack tip with probes 2S apart, so depth d = √[(c·t/2)² − S²]. With longitudinal velocity c = 5.92 mm/μs, S = 30 mm and t = 12.0 μs, c·t/2 = 35.52 mm and d = √(35.52² − 30²) ≈ 19.0 mm; at t = 12.5 μs, d ≈ 21.7 mm, so 0.5 μs corresponds to about 2.7 mm of depth. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢測人員應具 ASNT 或 ISO 9712 等級資格，以含已知人工缺陷的標準試片校正儀器；同一條裂縫至少用兩種方法交叉確認，長度以裂尖兩端的標記與量尺照片記錄，並註明檢測溫度與表面處理狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspectors should be qualified to ASNT or ISO 9712 levels and calibrate their instruments on reference blocks with known artificial flaws; confirm each crack with at least two methods, record its length with marks at both tips and a scaled photograph, and note test temperature and surface condition.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 非破壞檢測定位與量測裂縫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Locating and sizing cracks by NDT: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「染色滲透、磁粉與超音波」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dye penetrant, MT and ultrasonics” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢測人員應具 ASNT 或 ISO 9712 等級資格，以含已知人工缺陷的標準試片校正儀器；同一條裂縫至少用兩種方法交叉確認，長度以裂尖兩端的標記與量尺照片記錄，並註明檢測溫度與表面處理狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspectors should be qualified to ASNT or ISO 9712 levels and calibrate their instruments on reference blocks with known artificial flaws; confirm each crack with at least two methods, record its length with marks at both tips and a scaled photograph, and note test temperature and surface condition. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：檢測程序書要寫明去漆範圍、檢測方法、驗收與記錄格式，並規定當天完成局部補漆；所有裂縫都在構件上以油漆筆標示裂尖與日期，便於下次檢查判斷是否成長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The inspection procedure must define paint-removal extent, test method, acceptance and record format, and require local recoating the same day; mark every crack tip and the date on the steel with a paint pen so the next inspection can tell whether it has grown.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：隔著油漆做磁粉檢測，或去漆後未清除鏽皮，容易漏判短裂縫；把焊道表面的咬邊或研磨痕誤判為裂縫，則會導致不必要的鑽孔與補強，反而增加新的應力集中。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Magnetic particle testing through paint, or after paint removal without cleaning off scale, easily misses short cracks; mistaking undercut or grinding marks for cracks leads to unnecessary drilling and strengthening that adds new stress concentrations. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 非破壞檢測定位與量測裂縫：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「染色滲透、磁粉與超音波」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dye penetrant, MT and ultrasonics” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 隔著油漆做磁粉檢測，或去漆後未清除鏽皮，容易漏判短裂縫；把焊道表面的咬邊或研磨痕誤判為裂縫，則會導致不必要的鑽孔與補強，反而增加新的應力集中。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Magnetic particle testing through paint, or after paint removal without cleaning off scale, easily misses short cracks; mistaking undercut or grinding marks for cracks leads to unnecessary drilling and strengthening that adds new stress concentrations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：檢測前必須去除油漆與鏽皮，檢測後再補塗防蝕。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 現場應變量測與有效應力範圍：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Field strain measurement and effective stress range: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「焊趾應變計與雨流計數」如何影響鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Weld-toe gauges and rainflow counting” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 設計用的疲勞卡車與實際交通差異很大，評估既有橋最可靠的做法是在疲勞敏感細節附近貼應變計，連續記錄一到數週的實際交通反應。以雨流計數法把不規則的應變歷時拆成一個個循環，再依 Miner 線性累積損傷把不同大小的循環換算成一個等效常幅應力範圍。量測也能找出模型沒有考慮的效應，例如變形誘發的二次彎曲或支承卡死造成的額外應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「焊趾應變計與雨流計數」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The design fatigue truck differs greatly from real traffic, so the most reliable assessment of an existing bridge puts strain gauges near fatigue-sensitive details and records actual traffic for one to several weeks. Rainflow counting splits the irregular strain history into individual cycles, and Miner's linear damage rule converts cycles of different sizes into one equivalent constant-amplitude stress range. Measurements also reveal effects the model omits, such as distortion-induced secondary bending or extra stress from seized bearings. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Weld-toe gauges and rainflow counting” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 現場應變量測與有效應力範圍：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Field strain measurement and effective stress range: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「焊趾應變計與雨流計數」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Weld-toe gauges and rainflow counting” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：有效應力範圍 S_re = (Σγ_i·S_i³)^(1/3)。雨流計數得 60% 循環為 10 MPa、30% 為 20 MPa、10% 為 40 MPa：S_re = (0.6×1,000 + 0.3×8,000 + 0.1×64,000)^(1/3) = 9,400^(1/3) ≈ 21.1 MPa。E 類 N = 3.61×10¹¹/21.1³ ≈ 3.8×10⁷ 次，每天 3,000 次約 35 年。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Effective stress range S_re = (Σγ_i·S_i³)^(1/3). If rainflow counting gives 60% of cycles at 10 MPa, 30% at 20 MPa and 10% at 40 MPa, S_re = (0.6×1,000 + 0.3×8,000 + 0.1×64,000)^(1/3) = 9,400^(1/3) ≈ 21.1 MPa. For Category E, N = 3.61×10¹¹/21.1³ ≈ 3.8×10⁷ cycles, about 35 years at 3,000 cycles a day. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：應變計距焊趾保持固定距離並避開應力梯度最陡處，以已知重量的試驗卡車做標定行車，確認量到的應力與影響線計算相符；長期記錄要涵蓋平日與週末，並剔除溫度漂移造成的假循環。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place gauges at a fixed distance from the weld toe, away from the steepest stress gradient, and run a calibration truck of known weight to confirm that measured stresses match influence-line calculations; long-term records must cover weekdays and weekends, with spurious cycles from thermal drift removed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Effective stress range S_re = (Σγ_i·S_i³)^(1/3). If rainflow counting gives 60% of cycles at 10 MPa, 30% at 20 MPa and 10% at 40 MPa, S_re = (0.6×1,000 + 0.3×8,000 + 0.1×64,000)^(1/3) = 9,400^(1/3) ≈ 21.1 MPa. For Category E, N = 3.61×10¹¹/21.1³ ≈ 3.8×10⁷ cycles, about 35 years at 3,000 cycles a day. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「現場應變量測與有效應力範圍」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Field strain measurement and effective stress range", which statement holds?
options: 有效應力範圍 S_re = (Σγ_i·S_i³)^(1/3)。
只要最大應力低於降伏強度，鋼橋就不會發生疲勞裂縫。
鋼材是延性材料，所以鋼橋只會先變形再破壞，不會突然斷裂。
optionsEn: Effective stress range S_re = (Σγ_i·S_i³)^(1/3).
As long as peak stress stays below yield, a steel bridge cannot develop fatigue cracks.
Steel is ductile, so a steel bridge always deforms visibly before it fails and never fractures suddenly.
quiz.explanation: 有效應力範圍 S_re = (Σγ_i·S_i³)^(1/3)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Effective stress range S_re = (Σγ_i·S_i³)^(1/3). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 現場應變量測與有效應力範圍：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Field strain measurement and effective stress range: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「焊趾應變計與雨流計數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Weld-toe gauges and rainflow counting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 應變計距焊趾保持固定距離並避開應力梯度最陡處，以已知重量的試驗卡車做標定行車，確認量到的應力與影響線計算相符；長期記錄要涵蓋平日與週末，並剔除溫度漂移造成的假循環。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place gauges at a fixed distance from the weld toe, away from the steepest stress gradient, and run a calibration truck of known weight to confirm that measured stresses match influence-line calculations; long-term records must cover weekdays and weekends, with spurious cycles from thermal drift removed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：量測報告要附上應變計位置照片、標定車重、取樣頻率、濾波設定與雨流計數門檻，並把 S_re、每日循環數與剩餘壽命一起列入疲勞清冊，作為交通量改變時重新評估的基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The measurement report should attach gauge-location photographs, calibration truck weight, sampling rate, filter settings and rainflow thresholds, and enter S_re, daily cycles and remaining life into the fatigue inventory as the baseline for reassessment when traffic changes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只量幾個小時或只在離峰時段量測，會低估重車循環與最大應力範圍；忽略低於門檻的小循環在有大循環存在時仍會造成損傷，也會讓剩餘壽命估得過於樂觀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Recording for only a few hours, or only off-peak, underestimates heavy-truck cycles and the maximum stress range; ignoring that small cycles below the threshold still cause damage when larger cycles are present makes the remaining-life estimate too optimistic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 應變計距焊趾保持固定距離並避開應力梯度最陡處，以已知重量的試驗卡車做標定行車，確認量到的應力與影響線計算相符；長期記錄要涵蓋平日與週末，並剔除溫度漂移造成的假循環。

knowledge.textEn: The measurement report should attach gauge-location photographs, calibration truck weight, sampling rate, filter settings and rainflow thresholds, and enter S_re, daily cycles and remaining life into the fatigue inventory as the baseline for reassessment when traffic changes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「現場應變量測與有效應力範圍」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Field strain measurement and effective stress range"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
應變計距焊趾保持固定距離並避開應力梯度最陡處，以已知重量的試驗卡車做標定行車，確認量到的應力與影響線計算相符。
止裂孔越小越好，因為開孔會削弱斷面。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Place gauges at a fixed distance from the weld toe, away from the steepest stress gradient, and run a calibration truck of known weight to confirm that measured stresses match influence-line calculations.
Arrest holes should be as small as possible because holes weaken the section.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 現場應變量測與有效應力範圍：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Field strain measurement and effective stress range: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「焊趾應變計與雨流計數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Weld-toe gauges and rainflow counting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只量幾個小時或只在離峰時段量測，會低估重車循環與最大應力範圍；忽略低於門檻的小循環在有大循環存在時仍會造成損傷，也會讓剩餘壽命估得過於樂觀。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Recording for only a few hours, or only off-peak, underestimates heavy-truck cycles and the maximum stress range; ignoring that small cycles below the threshold still cause damage when larger cycles are present makes the remaining-life estimate too optimistic. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量測也能找出模型沒有考慮的效應，例如變形誘發的二次彎曲或支承卡死造成的額外應力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Measurements also reveal effects the model omits, such as distortion-induced secondary bending or extra stress from seized bearings.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「疲勞評估只要用規範的疲勞卡車計算，不需要現場量測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fatigue assessment needs only the code fatigue truck, never field measurement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只量幾個小時或只在離峰時段量測，會低估重車循環與最大應力範圍；忽略低於門檻的小循環在有大循環存在時仍會造成損傷，也會讓剩餘壽命估得過於樂觀。
knowledge.textEn: Recording for only a few hours, or only off-peak, underestimates heavy-truck cycles and the maximum stress range; ignoring that small cycles below the threshold still cause damage when larger cycles are present makes the remaining-life estimate too optimistic.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「現場應變量測與有效應力範圍」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Field strain measurement and effective stress range" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
裂縫修復完成後就可以恢復一般的兩年檢查週期，不必再追蹤。
只量幾個小時或只在離峰時段量測，會低估重車循環與最大應力範圍；忽略低於門檻的小循環在有大循環存在時仍會造成損傷，也會讓剩餘壽命估得過於樂觀。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Once a crack is repaired, the normal two-year cycle can resume without follow-up.
Recording for only a few hours, or only off-peak, underestimates heavy-truck cycles and the maximum stress range.
quiz.explanation: 只量幾個小時或只在離峰時段量測，會低估重車循環與最大應力範圍；忽略低於門檻的小循環在有大循環存在時仍會造成損傷，也會讓剩餘壽命估得過於樂觀。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Recording for only a few hours, or only off-peak, underestimates heavy-truck cycles and the maximum stress range; ignoring that small cycles below the threshold still cause damage when larger cycles are present makes the remaining-life estimate too optimistic. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「檢查間隔與修復後追蹤」與「斷裂關鍵構件管理與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Inspection intervals and post-repair follow-up" and "Fracture-critical member management and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 檢查間隔與修復後追蹤：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Inspection intervals and post-repair follow-up: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「修復後追蹤檢查週期」如何影響鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-repair inspection interval” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 修復不是終點：止裂孔可能重新起裂、拼接板邊緣成為新的起點，未修的同類細節也可能陸續出現裂縫。FHWA 手冊指出，對常見的冗餘橋梁，最好的選擇常常不是修復而是監測裂縫，面外變形造成的裂縫尤其如此。檢查間隔應由可偵測的最小裂縫、臨界裂縫與成長速率決定，而不只是套用固定的兩年週期；偵測能力越差，所需的檢查頻率就越高。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「修復後追蹤檢查週期」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Repair is not the end: arrest holes can re-initiate, splice-plate edges can become new origins, and unrepaired details of the same type may crack in turn. The FHWA manual notes that for common redundant bridges the best choice is often to monitor rather than repair a crack, especially one caused by out-of-plane distortion. Inspection intervals should follow from the smallest detectable crack, the critical crack and the growth rate, not just a fixed two-year cycle; the poorer the detection capability, the more often one must inspect. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Post-repair inspection interval” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：沿用第 4 單元（Δσ = 40 MPa、a_c = 113 mm）：非破壞檢測能可靠偵測 5 mm 裂縫時，剩餘約 6.5×10⁶ 次 ≈ 8.9 年；若只靠目視、25 mm 才看得到，只剩約 1.9×10⁶ 次 ≈ 2.7 年。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Using unit 4 (Δσ = 40 MPa, a_c = 113 mm): if NDT reliably detects a 5 mm crack, about 6.5×10⁶ cycles ≈ 8.9 years remain; if only visual inspection finds it at 25 mm, only about 1.9×10⁶ cycles ≈ 2.7 years remain.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「裂縫修復完成後就可以恢復一般的兩年檢查週期，不必再追蹤。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a crack is repaired, the normal two-year cycle can resume without follow-up." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「修復後追蹤檢查週期」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Post-repair inspection interval”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：裂縫修復完成後就可以恢復一般的兩年檢查週期，不必再追蹤。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a crack is repaired, the normal two-year cycle can resume without follow-up. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「檢查間隔與修復後追蹤」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Inspection intervals and post-repair follow-up" is correct?

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前核對檔案是否涵蓋所有斷裂關鍵構件的位置圖、檢查程序、近接方式（橋檢車、繩索或吊籃）、歷次裂縫圖與修復圖說；抽查幾處現場標記與檔案是否一致，並確認檢查團隊負責人的資格與近接設備已排定。

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斷裂關鍵構件檔案」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fracture-critical member file” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前核對檔案是否涵蓋所有斷裂關鍵構件的位置圖、檢查程序、近接方式（橋檢車、繩索或吊籃）、歷次裂縫圖與修復圖說；抽查幾處現場標記與檔案是否一致，並確認檢查團隊負責人的資格與近接設備已排定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observation: 現場實務：維護手冊列出每一個斷裂關鍵構件的檢查程序、近接方法、必要的非破壞檢測與通報門檻；發現疑似斷裂時，第一線檢查員必須有權立即封橋並通報業主，這項權責要在交接時寫清楚。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance manual lists, for each fracture-critical member, the inspection procedure, access method, required NDT and reporting thresholds; when a fracture is suspected, the front-line inspector must have authority to close the bridge immediately and notify the owner, and that authority must be written down at handover.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若檔案只保留結論而缺少裂縫量測資料，新的檢查團隊無法計算成長率，也無法判斷修復是否有效；近接設備若未事先安排，容易以遠距目視或空拍取代近距離檢查，正是讓斷裂長期未被發現的條件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
